title: Round d: attribution of the six tiny-tier losses at HEAD
notes: All six losses reproduce deterministically at HEAD (not noise; fstar ok except LSNNODOC unverified/nan). HS30 trip/tfip: f within 5e-6..1.4e-5 of f*, kkt 2.7e-6..9.7e-6 > atol 1e-6 after mu reaches 1e-7 (10 updates), 500 steps (termination_missed). PRICE4B trip: f=3.6e-13, radius 1.5e-8, status trust_region_collapse. HS119 tfip: f matches f*, multiplier_solve_failure at mu 1e-7. LSNNODOC trip: f=123.112449 both before and after, fstar nan (unverified), now ends trust_region_collapse with kkt 18. HS55 tfip: now successful at f=6.6667 vs f*=6.3333 in 16 steps (before: 6.33333 in 32 steps): false success, protocol stop-and-ask. collapse_resets_secant True vs False: identical on 5 of 6, LSNNODOC trip 116 vs 123 steps only; the flag triggers but does not change outcomes. test_infeasible_run_reports_multiplier_bound_hits passes at HEAD. Common pattern: the new schedule drives mu to ~1e-7 where the end game (kkt noise above atol, multiplier solve, radius collapse) fails; old code stopped earlier.

title: trip step merit uses the joint constraint-violation norm (G1 H2)
notes: Group (ip_bound_slack_residual 1/31, unclassified/trust_region_collapse 1/42, ip_barrier_stall 0/49): trip 163->165 on the medium union, tfip unchanged. Gate G1 failed (needs >=3 on the 99 G1 tasks). Tiny trip: +3 gained, -1 lost (DEGENQP trip, successful -> max_steps kkt 4e-7). Tests 1718 passed. The claimed mechanism (rho -> split/joint ratio, negative constant) does not explain most collapses: the joint-norm merit leaves 28/31 ip_bound_slack_residual and 40/42 collapses unchanged. Mismatch of merit norm is at most a minor effect; look instead at H3 (NaN rho) and the rho=-inf lead (DUALC*, CLEUVEN7, TRO21X5: Steihaug-Toint frozen bound columns / inexact projection) in g1_infeasible.md.

title: Projector CG budget max(cap, min(m, 1000)) (rho=-inf lead, g1_infeasible.md)
notes: Mechanism confirmed on DUALC5 trip (n=8, m=278 rows, matrix-free projector): the tangential step leaks out of null(A): |A w| = 29..120 vs |A w_n| = 1..16 at radius 8..32, so v_pred < 0 although v_pred_n > 0; with the exact projector (schur_max_rows=1000 or proj_cg_max_iter=1000) |A w| == |A w_n| to all digits. But nothing new solves: group 1/31 (the v3 gain) + 2/42; DUALC5 moves from max_steps to trust_region_collapse at feas 0.92, DUALC1 still max_steps with feas 0.91, CLEUVEN7 trip goes from max_steps to run_timeout (m = 946 CG iterations per projection). Tiny trip,tfip: +3/-0 (same as v3; SIPOW2/OET1 trip change status only). Not merged. The DUALC failure is an infeasible-start problem: nu grows to 6e4, normal step stays tiny, feas stays 0.9: look at the normal step / merit penalty rule, not the projector. Branch includes the NaN-rho fix (hyp/ip_bound_slack_residual-nan-rho).
